newsitem.title: bangladesh: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The District and Session Judge's Court yesterday ordered the six arrested (including ex-army officers) accused in Bangabandhu (Sheikh Mujibur Rahman) murder case to appear in the court on March 12.
Jatiya Sangsad (parliament) last night passed the Bankruptcy Act 1997, in an amended form, envisaging effective and speedy realisation of outstanding bank loan.
Donor agencies may delay release of funds for the $175 million fourth Dhaka water supply project as the government has failed to comply with several conditions laid down by them.
Prime Minister of Pakistan Nawaz Sharif yesterday said his country laid emphasis on closest relationship with Bangladesh.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina called upon the members of the armed forces to work for building a poverty and hunger free prosperous Bangladesh with the same spirit and dedication with which they had fought the war of liberation.

Opposition MPs (legislators) on Tuesday alleged that public life has become endangered due to widespread terrorism in the country while the treasury benchers claimed restoration of peace and stability in social life.

The Asian Development Bank (ADB) will give maximum thrust on rural development in its future programmes in Bangladesh. This was revealed Tuesday at a meeting between Bangladesh government and ADB officials in Dhaka.
